## Functional Dependencies

### Tables
\begin{aligned}
\texttt{restaurants.rid} &\to \texttt{servers.rid}\\
\texttt{visits.visittime} &\to \texttt{bill.billid}\\
\texttt{paymentmethods.pmid} &\to \texttt{bill.pmid}\\
\texttt{visits.serverempid} &\to \texttt{restaurants.rid}\\
\texttt{visits.restaurantid} &\to \texttt{customers.cid}\\
\texttt{visits.waittime} &\to \texttt{mealtypes.mtid}\\
\texttt{visits.visitdate} &\to \texttt{servers.empid}\\
\end{aligned}

### restaurants 
\begin{aligned}
\texttt{restaurants.rid} &\to \texttt{servers.rid}\\
\texttt{visits.serverempid} &\to \texttt{restaurants.rid}\\
\end{aligned}

### servers 
\begin{aligned}
\texttt{empID} &\to \texttt{servername},\ \texttt{startdatehired},\ \texttt{enddatehired},\ \texttt{hourlyrate},\\
&\quad \texttt{birthdate},\ \texttt{ssn},\ \texttt{rid}
\end{aligned}


### customers
\begin{aligned}
\texttt{visits.restaurantid} &\to \texttt{customers.cid}\\
\end{aligned}

### visits 
\begin{aligned}
\texttt{visits.visittime} &\to \texttt{bill.billid}\\
\texttt{visits.serverempid} &\to \texttt{restaurants.rid}\\
\texttt{visits.restaurantid} &\to \texttt{customers.cid}\\
\texttt{visits.waittime} &\to \texttt{mealtypes.mtid}\\
\texttt{visits.visitdate} &\to \texttt{servers.empid}\\
\end{aligned}

### bill
\begin{aligned}
\texttt{visits.visittime} &\to \texttt{bill.billid}\\
\texttt{paymentmethods.pmid} &\to \texttt{bill.pmid}\\
\end{aligned}

### paymentmethods
\begin{aligned}
\texttt{paymentmethods.pmid} &\to \texttt{bill.pmid}\\
\end{aligned}

### mealtypes 
\begin{aligned}
\texttt{visits.waittime} &\to \texttt{mealtypes.mtid}\\
\end{aligned}

</br>
